• While converting the** interrogative sentence of direct speech into indirect speech**, it is changed into an **assertive sentence.**

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The school is organizing a cultural event.

options.text: A cultural event is organized by the school.
A cultural event is being organized by the school.
A cultural event was organized by the school.
A cultural event has been organized by the school.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**A cultural event is being organized by the school**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and 'The school' is the subject and '**a cultural event**' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'The school' of the active voice becomes the object, the object '**a cultural event**' becomes the subject.
 
• The passive format "'is + being + V3 (organized)" should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present continuous tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2*.*
